name: Recreation Vehicle
description: A recreation vehicle or off-highway vehicle: any motor vehicle designed or modified for recreation over unimproved terrain, including off-highway motorcycles and dirt bikes, so an off-road electric dirt bike is one. Registered with the Massachusetts Environmental Police.

restrictions.rule: Designed or modified for use over unimproved terrain, including off-highway motorcycles and dirt bikes, with no limit on power or speed
Registered with the director of environmental law enforcement, with the number displayed on both sides, renewed every two years
No driver's license or learner's permit needed
Riders under 18 must complete an approved recreation vehicle safety and responsibility course, and a parent of a rider under 16 must attend a session
Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting the registrar's standards
Kept off public ways and controlled-access highway rights-of-way, except to cross at marked trail crossings or on ways designated to link riding areas
A rider under 16½ may cross a public way only with a driver's license or under direct supervision by someone 18 or older
On public land, ridden only on trails marked for such vehicles or with the owner's permission; on private land, only with the owner's written permission or posted designation

Can be forfeited after a second violation of its operating rules, or a conviction for leaving the scene of a crash that injured someone or for reckless or negligent riding that seriously injured or killed someone
